instruction: Bold all email addresses found in the document.

parameters.window_name: 04 CHIN9505 EBook Purchasing info 2021 Jan.docx - LibreOffice Writer

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding and making all email addresses bold. The document contains at least one email address (service@blcup.com or similar). Evaluator uses regex pattern to find email addresses and checks if they are formatted as bold. Score is the ratio of bolded emails to total emails found.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts email addresses using standard regex pattern and checks run.font.bold property
Metric correctly calculates ratio of bold emails to total emails (returns 1.0 only if ALL emails are bold)
Postconfig appropriately saves document with Ctrl+S to ensure getter reads updated state
Evaluator fully covers instruction requirement: checks that ALL email addresses are bold
Logic handles typical use cases correctly with proper edge case handling (returns 0.0 if no emails found)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor edge case: If a single email address spans multiple runs with different formatting (e.g., partially bold), the current logic may record it multiple times with dict overwriting to last occurrence. This is unlikely in typical documents but could be improved by tracking character-level bold status.
